b.x: BINDING VERSION: PORTUGUESE.
Language
The binding legal version is Portuguese. EN and ES are reading. The Portuguese text governs.
1. Controller
Jeremias .s, Porto Alegre/RS, Brazil. Data-subject channel: contatohomemcinza@gmail.com.
2. Purpose of this policy
To state clearly how personal data is processed on this site, under arts. 9 and 18 of Brazilian Law 13.709/2018 (LGPD).
3. What the site does and which data
This list is the same as the sheet at /ficha. If a function is added or removed, both pages change the same day.
Guide reading and audio in Portuguese, English and Spanish.
Water, stores, kit, blackout, camp, fishing and a family plan. Educational text.
First aid as education, including stroke, heart attack, breath, fainting and a bite. It does not diagnose. In Brazil the number is 192.
Brazil’s emergency numbers written on the screen. Outside Brazil the number is different. The page is not the service.
A food and pantry calculator, on the device itself.
Light, magnifier, compass and a note.
A care schedule for a bedridden person, with the time set by the carer.
A home-screen shortcut and reading of what was already opened, offline, when the device kept it.
A link shelf at /loja. It does not charge. It does not create an account. It does not offer a firearm, ammunition, a shock device or gas.
Camera: only the magnifier, and only while you leave it on. The image is not sent.
Location: only the compass, at the moment you ask. It is not stored on a guide server.
Notification: only the care alert, if you accept. Without it, the time stays on the schedule and does not call.
Share: the phone’s own sheet, if it offers one. The guide does not build the contact list.
On the device, with no account: language, chosen voice, reading progress, a note, kit lists, the care schedule and times, and the choice to accept or refuse measurement.
It does not ask for an account, a tax number, a phone number or a payment.
It does not sell personal data. It has no ads.
It does not track location with the screen off.
It does not teach weapons, a militia or flight from the police.

Language, voice, progress, the note, lists, the care schedule and the measurement choice stay on the user’s device, so the guide works without an account. Basis: performance of the service requested by opening the site (art. 7, V).

Technical hosting/CDN logs (IP, date/time, browser), if the provider records them: security, operation and, where applicable, the legal duty to keep application-access logs (Brazilian Internet Bill of Rights, Law 12.965/2014, art. 15), for the period the law and the provider impose. Basis: legitimate interest in security (art. 7, IX) and/or legal obligation (art. 7, II), as the case may be.

An aggregate count of pages opened and of notebook downloads: a number, with no name, no IP stored by the guide, and no cookie. Only the author sees the total. Basis: legitimate interest in knowing whether the guide is being read (art. 7, IX).

The /loja shelf may hold a link pasted by the author. The click, if one exists, leaves the guide. The guide does not send a name, reading progress or location with that click. Today there is no affiliate cookie.
4. Cookies

See /cookies. There is no ad. The /loja shelf does not set an affiliate cookie. Language, voice, progress, the note and the schedule stay on the device and do not need a banner. Google Analytics, if it is switched on, loads only after acceptance and sends the visit to Google. Without acceptance, the script does not load. In this version measurement stays off until there is an identifier and acceptance. The author’s count uses no cookie. On /musica, the page background loads the YouTube player for the track Message of the source. That load talks to YouTube. The guide does not send a name, reading progress or location with it, and the title Message of the source opens the same video on YouTube. The Translate button, if you choose a language, sends the visible page text and the spoken passage to Google Translate. The choice stays only on this device. A field you type in is not part of that send.
5. Sharing
Only operators needed to host and deliver the site (publishing platform, CDN, DNS). No sale of data. No list to a commercial third party.
6. International transfer
The site may pass through infrastructure outside Brazil (hosting/CDN). When that happens, technical log data follows the operator only to deliver the page and protect the service.
7. Retention
Progress, the note, voice, lists and the schedule on the device: the user erases them by clearing the browser data.
Provider logs: the minimum needed or the legal period applicable to the application provider.
We keep no registration file, because there is no account.
8. Data-subject rights (art. 18)

Confirmation, access, correction, anonymisation, blocking or deletion of what is excessive or processed in breach, objection, withdrawal of consent when processing is based on consent, information about sharing. The request stays on this site: email contatohomemcinza@gmail.com. The guide does not send the reader to another page.
How to exercise: email contatohomemcinza@gmail.com, subject “LGPD”. Reply within 15 days.
9. Security
HTTPS. No password on the site. The guide’s own rule: do not post a kit, a stock, a child or a route.
10. Children and adolescents
We do not direct collection at anyone under 18. We do not ask for a child’s data.
11. Data-protection officer

At this size and volume, the data-subject channel replaces disclosing a formal DPO, under ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD 2/2022, so long as the channel on this page works. If the operation grows (account, sale, marketing), this page will be updated.
12. Changes
When the site gains or loses a function — camera, location, alerts, an account, payment, an ad or a cookie — this page and the sheet at /ficha are updated the same day, with the new date at the top.
13. Channel
Whoever wants to talk about their own data writes to contatohomemcinza@gmail.com. The subject is “LGPD”. The reply leaves from here. No outbound link.
14. In force
1 October 2026.
